title: Julia
summary_html:
This article is about the companion of the Avatar. For other uses, see Julia (Disambiguation).

Julia is a well-known tinker and long time companion of the Avatar of legend. While her origins are not explicitly known, she is possessed of a longevity characteristic of Earth natives living in Britannia, and has dwelt in the realm for several centuries, having been present in Lord British's lands from Ultima IV through Ultima IX.
